WITH modifies AS (
    SELECT cr, section_id FROM cr_modifies_section
    UNION
    SELECT cr, section_id FROM section_modified_by
), membership AS (
    SELECT cr, pack_id FROM cr_in_pack
    UNION
    SELECT cr, pack_id FROM pack_member
), verified AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.target AS cr, d.code AS code, m.label AS wg_meeting
    FROM disposition AS d
    JOIN resolution AS r ON r.id = d.resolution_id
    JOIN meeting AS m ON m.id = r.meeting_id
    WHERE d.evidence_status = 'source_verified'
      AND d.scope = 'whole_target'
      AND m.wg = 'RAN1'
), changes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.id AS cr, d.number AS document,
           d.target_release AS release, s.id AS section_id,
           s.spec AS specification, s.clause AS clause
    FROM document AS d
    JOIN modifies AS x ON x.cr = d.id
    JOIN section AS s ON s.id = x.section_id
                     AND s.release = d.target_release
                     AND s.spec = d.spec
    WHERE d.doc_type = 'tdoc:CR'
), packed AS (
    SELECT c.cr, c.document, c.release, c.section_id,
           c.specification, c.clause, p.pack_number,
           p.tsg_meeting, p.tsg_number
    FROM changes AS c
    JOIN membership AS x ON x.cr = c.cr
    JOIN cr_pack AS p ON p.id = x.pack_id
), seed AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.document, p.specification, p.clause,
           p.release, p.section_id, p.tsg_number
    FROM packed AS p
    WHERE p.pack_number = 'RP-231232'
      AND p.release IN ('Rel-17')
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM verified AS v WHERE v.cr = p.cr)
)
SELECT DISTINCT s.specification AS specification,
       s.clause AS clause,
       h.pack_number AS cr_pack,
       h.tsg_meeting AS tsg_meeting
FROM seed AS s
JOIN packed AS h ON h.section_id = s.section_id AND h.release = s.release
WHERE h.tsg_number = (
    SELECT MAX(p.tsg_number)
    FROM packed AS p
    WHERE p.section_id = s.section_id
      AND p.release = s.release
      AND p.tsg_number < s.tsg_number
);
